//: Loop settings for the hireworthy product repo. Every plugin an unattended run may need is enabled up front, because a run cannot reload its own plugin set mid-flight; the cost is each skill's description and nothing else until one is invoked.

permissions.//: Allow what a tick in THIS repo genuinely needs, so a timer never blocks on a prompt nobody is there to answer.
permissions.//deny: Deny beats allow, and these are the difference between a loop that can only propose and one that can destroy. Note what deny can and cannot see: it matches the Bash string, so it stops an improvised `gh pr merge` but NOT a merge inside a script. The authoritative control is autonomy.level in workflow.json. Treat this list as the belt, not the braces, and remove nothing from it.
